heading: How ranking works
paragraphs: The Top 21 sponsor board ranks participants by cumulative USD contributions. Every confirmed crypto payment adds to your total. Anyone can outbid you at any time — rank is not locked. This is paid placement beside the live Bitcoin price, not an endorsement by PRICEB.TC.

heading: How to pay
paragraphs: Send BTC (SegWit), USDT (TRC20), or USDC (Solana) to the deposit address shown after you choose an asset. The Soft-OPEN minimum is $10 USD. Every confirmed payment adds to your cumulative USD total and updates your rank. Payments are final; being outbid does not trigger a refund.

heading: Watching & confirmations
paragraphs: After you send, click I've sent the payment so we start watching the deposit address. Keep the tab open if you can. API watch windows are typically ~1 minute for USDT/USDC and ~30 minutes for BTC — these are product field estimates, not service-level guarantees. The status badge updates when the watcher sees your deposit. After your first confirmed payment, you can submit your profile to appear on the Top 21 leaderboard and home placements.

heading: Profile & soft-gate
paragraphs: After your first confirmed payment, add your project name, logo (optional), HTTPS website, and one-line description. Use a truthful name. No explicit sexual content, malware, phishing, scams, impersonation, or illegal content. Unpaid logos stay off the home and board. Suspicious entries may require review. We can reject or hide content, including in historical results, and block domains. Payments remain recorded. After your first submission, profile changes require operator review.

heading: Where you appear
paragraphs: Sponsors appear in home placements: hero spot #01, strip #02, and logo rail ranks #03–07 below the chart. The full Top 21 leaderboard is visible at /sponsors. Rankings update as payments confirm. Your rank depends on your cumulative USD total; anyone can outbid you at any time.

heading: Honesty
paragraphs: No fake brands or invented metrics. Empty slots stay empty. Paid placement does not constitute financial advice or an endorsement. Check the Bitcoin price source and methodology at /methodology. Session data, invoices, and payment evidence are private; public profiles and totals are visible. Technical logs are retained for 30 days, analytics for 90 days. Payments and minimal accounting evidence have no automatic deletion.
Contact contact@foreign.rodeo for operational problems or content reports. Never send wallet seeds or private keys.
